subject: masonry
intro: Masonry leads to the building trades that raise walls, set stone and finish concrete by hand — and to the inspectors who judge whether that work will stand for a century.

roles.title: Brickmasons and Blockmasons
roles.what: Lay and bind brick, structural tile, concrete block, cinder block, glass block and terra-cotta with mortar to construct or repair walls, partitions, arches, sewers and other structures.
roles.where: The brick and block laying unit is the job itself — bonds and patterns, holding level, plumb and gauge, and jointing and tooling, all built on the mortar mixing and material grades from the materials unit.

roles.title: Stonemasons
roles.what: Build stone structures such as piers, walls and abutments, and lay walks, curbstones and special masonry for vats, tanks and floors — shaping and setting each stone so the load travels where it should.
roles.where: The stone and specialty work unit covers stone types and setting, anchored and adhered veneer, and reinforced masonry — exactly the assemblies stonemasons build and the course's quality-control topics hold them to.

roles.title: Tile and Stone Setters
roles.what: Apply hard tile, stone and comparable materials to walls, floors, ceilings, countertops and roof decks, cutting and bedding each piece onto prepared surfaces for a flat, durable finish.
roles.where: Mortar types and mixing from the materials unit, the level-and-plumb discipline of the laying unit, and the weather-resistance unit's drainage thinking all transfer directly to setting tile and stone that stays put.

roles.title: Construction and Building Inspectors
roles.what: Inspect structures to determine structural soundness and compliance with specifications, building codes and other regulations — sometimes broadly, sometimes for a single system such as masonry or plumbing.
roles.where: The course's inspection and quality control unit, weather-resistance testing of flashing and weeps, and the material grades knowledge base are precisely what an inspector checks on a masonry site.

roles.title: Helpers--Brickmasons, Blockmasons, Stonemasons, and Tile and Marble Setters
roles.what: Assist masons by supplying and mixing mortar, carrying and stockpiling brick, block and stone, erecting scaffolding, and keeping the work area ready — the apprenticeship gateway into the laying trades.
roles.where: Mason's tools, site and material handling safety, and scaffolding basics from the first unit, plus estimating materials from the mortar unit, are the daily skills of a mason's helper.
